svg.title: Map sheet, printing sites 1 to 24
svg.desc: The campground's survey map as Reconcile shows it when it prints sites 1 to 24: brown contours, the creek, the one-way loop road with black site squares, a scale bar and a north arrow. Every site is printed, and Tam's pencil rings the three that are not on the ground.
svg.text: Marisol says it starts at four.
